title: Design Plugin — per-repo config
description: Per-repo configuration consumed by the design plugin's dev-server, slash commands, and skills. Place at <repo>/.design/config.json.

name.description: Short repo / product name. Shown in server header and as a token in skill prompts.

projectLabel.description: Long label for the design browser (window title and big H1). Defaults to <name> + ' Design'.

designRoot.description: Repo-relative root where canvas + design system files live. Default convention: '.design' (top-level, alongside .git, .claude, etc.). Older repos may use '.ai/design'.

canvasGroups.description: Top-level groupings shown in the file tree. Each entry maps a folder under designRoot to a sidebar section.

path.description: Folder under designRoot to scan for .html canvases.

rootClass.description: Body / canvas root CSS class that the project's tokens are scoped under. Generated canvases use <body class="<rootClass>">.

themeDefault.description: Default theme attribute (data-theme) for new canvases.

tokensCssRel.description: Path to the design system CSS, relative to designRoot. New canvases <link> to this file.

teamAccentDefault.description: Optional default value for data-team attribute on new canvases. Set to null if the project doesn't use multi-team accent overrides.

handoffTargets.description: Where /design:handoff emits target artifacts. Empty array disables handoff. Special `path` values: `registry:item` emits a shadcn registry-item.json sidecar next to the canvas (Phase 3.6 default — consume via `bunx shadcn add file://./<Slug>.registry.json`). Any other path is treated as a repo-relative target dir for legacy direct-migration handoff. Recommended single-entry default: `[{ label: 'shadcn registry', path: 'registry:item', platform: 'web' }]`.

path.description: `registry:item` for shadcn sidecar emit, or repo-relative target dir for direct migration.

newCanvasDir.description: Default folder (under designRoot) where /design:new scaffolds new canvas .tsx files (Phase 3.6+; older repos may still hold .html canvases pending one-shot migration).

newComponentDir.description: Default folder (under designRoot) where /design:new puts shared component .jsx files.

extensions.description: User-added directories the docs renderer / completeness-critic should track but not validate against the standard schema. Each entry maps a folder (under the DS) to a label.

completenessProfile.description: Severity profile for the design-system-completeness-critic. 'minimal' = Core blockers only; 'standard' = Core + most Conventional checks; 'strict' = all checks incl. voice/tone/hard-stops in README.

activeFamilies.description: Token families this project has in scope. Computed during /design:setup-ds. The completeness-critic uses this to gate Conventional checks (e.g. type-mono specimen only required when 'mono' is here).

accentStrategy.description: How many --accent* families exist. The completeness-critic C7 gates the actual family count against this declaration. Default: 'single' (backwards-compatible). 'chromatic-N' is parameterized — write the literal N (e.g. 'chromatic-5'). Per DDR-043.

colorSpace.description: Color space the project uses in tokens CSS. The completeness-critic V2 gates the actual token format against this declaration. Default: 'oklch' (backwards-compatible). Per DDR-043.

designSystems.description: Design systems available in this project. Single-DS projects have one entry; multi-DS projects (marketing vs. admin vs. mobile) list each here. Each canvas's .meta.json declares which DS it uses via the 'designSystem' field.

name.description: Kebab-case slug. Used to match canvas .meta.json.designSystem references.

defaultDesignSystem.description: Name of the DS used when a canvas's .meta.json has no 'designSystem' field. For single-DS projects, this is the only DS. For multi-DS, pick the most common.
